C1279.title: Beijing's First Criminal Copyright Case Involving AI Image Alteration Sentenced
C1279.summary: Tongzhou District Procuratorate in Beijing disclosed the city first criminal copyright infringement case using AI. From March to July 2024, the criminal group misappropriated artworks by multiple creators, modified them with AI, and made puzzles for sale, selling more than 3,000 infringing puzzles with an illegal business amount of over 270,000 yuan. The case was prosecuted in May 2025 and sentenced or reported in June 2025; the court sentenced the involved company and Luo and others for copyright infringement.
